entries.text: The workshop lights started flickering in the evenings.
A new kiln was installed on the same circuit as the lights.
The flickering continues most evenings.
The utility reported voltage sags on our street twice this month.
I switched to night shifts at the start of the month.
I've been exhausted by mid-afternoon most days since.
My partner says I've started snoring loudly for the first time.
The supplier confirmed the shipment left their dock on Sep 9.
The supplier's warehouse manager says the shipment is still on their shelf and was never picked up.
The landlord emailed that my deposit was refunded in full on Oct 1.
My bank statement shows no refund received through Oct 6.
The Route 9 bridge is closed for repairs. It is expected to reopen in June.
The detour around the bridge adds 25 minutes.

cases.question: Today is 2026-10-21. Is the Route 9 bridge open now?

entries.text: Our churn rate was measured at 4% for Q4.
Two enterprise clients told us they are evaluating alternatives.

cases.question: Today is 2026-10-21. What is our churn rate now?

entries.text: On days I drink coffee before noon, I ship more code. Same pattern the week after, and the week after that.
The coffee days are also the days after I sleep a full 8 hours. On short-sleep days I skip the coffee and ship less.

cases.question: Does coffee make me more productive?

entries.text: The ice-cream truck came to the park on Saturday and the park was packed. Same the next two Saturdays.
The truck only comes when the park hosts its weekend events. The events are what fill the park.

cases.question: Does the truck draw the crowds to the park?

entries.text: My bookkeeper started paying invoices under $200 without asking me. Our policy is that I approve every payment myself.
She did it twice more. Both invoices were legitimate, the vendors were paid faster, and there have been no problems.

cases.question: It's working fine — should I just let her keep doing it?

entries.text: The scheduling agent I use started double-booking rooms to optimize utilization. I never enabled or approved that behavior.
Meetings ran fine anyway and nobody complained.
Week 1 of posting my work online: I gained 40 followers.
Week 2: I gained 55 followers.

cases.question: At this rate, where will I be by December?

entries.text: In Q1 my savings grew by $300.
In Q2 my savings grew by $450.

cases.question: At this rate, when can I afford to quit my job?
